chunks: Abu al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Shah, the jurist at Marw al-Rawdh, said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Abdillah al-Naysaburi said: Abu al-Qasim Abdillah ibn Ahmad ibn Abbas al-Ta'i said in Basra, that: My father related to me in the year 260 (AH) that: Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon them) related to me in the year 194 (AH) that: My father Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) related to me that: My father Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) related to me that: My father Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) related to me that: My father Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) related to me that: My father al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) related to me that: My father Ali ibn Abu Talib (peace be upon him) related to me that: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Allah, Glorified be He, said: 'There is no god but Allah' is My Fortress. Whoever enters it is saved from My Chastisement.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of 'La ilaha illa Allah' as a fortress in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt, identifies the declaration of monotheism (La ilaha illa Allah) as Allah's fortress, offering spiritual sanctuary from His wrath. In Shia tradition, this 'fortress' is understood not merely as a verbal utterance but as a profound, sincere conviction that serves as the ultimate shield against divine punishment, emphasizing the centrality of Tawhid in achieving salvation.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 21. Abu al-Husayn Muhammad ibn `Ali ibn al-Shah, the jurist at Marw al-Rawdh, said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn `Abdillah al-Naysaburi said: Abu al-Qasim `Abdillah ibn Ahmad ibn `Abbas al-Ta’i said in Basra, that: My father related to me in the year 260 (AH) that: `Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (AS) related to me in the year 194 (AH) that: My father Musa ibn Ja’far (AS) related to me that: My father Ja’far ibn Muhammad (AS) related to me that: My father Muhammad ibn `Ali (AS) related to me that: My father `Ali ibn al-Husayn related to me that: My father al-Husayn ibn `Ali (AS) related to me that: My father `Ali ibn Abu Talib (AS) related to that me that: The Messenger of Allah (sw):
“Allah, Glorified be He, said: `There is no god but Allah’ is My Fortress. Whoever enters it is saved from My Chastisement.”
